messages.content: photosynthesis k ho?

photosynthesis bhaneko birua le khana banaune tarika ho. paat ma bhayeko chlorophyll le ghaam ko prakash linchha, jara bata pani ra hawa bata carbon dioxide linchha, ani glucose (chini) banaunchha. yo kram ma oxygen nikalchha, jun hami sas ferda prayog garchhaun.
gravity kasari kaam garchha? sajilo bhasa ma

gravity bhaneko har bastu le arko bastu lai afno tira tanne bal ho. jati thulo mass, teti badhi tanchha. prithvi dherai thulo bhayeko le sabai kura tala khaschhan, ra chandrama pani prithvi ko gravity le garda yasko waripari ghumchha.
pani paryo kina hunchha?

ghaam le samudra, nadi ra tal ko pani tataunchha ani pani baph banera mathi janchha. mathi chiso hune bhayeko le baph sana thopa ma badalinchha ra badal banchha. thopa haru jodiera garho bhaepachhi pani parera tala jharchhan. yaslai water cycle bhanchhan.
bijuli kasari banchha nepal ma?

nepal ma dherai bijuli jalvidyut (hydropower) bata banchha. nadi ko bagdo pani le turbine ghumauchha, turbine sanga jodiyeko generator le bijuli nikalchha. nepal ma himal bata aune dherai nadi bhayeko le hydropower ko thulo sambhavana chha.
bhukampa kina aauchha?

prithvi ko mathillo patra thulo thulo plate ma bandiyeko chha, jun bistarai chalirahanchhan. nepal ma indian plate eurasian plate tira dhakelirahechha. plate haru bich jamma bhayeko tanab achanak chhutda jamin hallinchha, tyo nai bhukampa ho. 2072 saal ko gorkha bhukampa yasko udaharan ho.
himalaya kasari baneko ho?

karib 5 crore barsha agadi indian plate eurasian plate sanga thokkiyo. dubai plate thichiera jamin mathi uthyo ra himalaya baniyo. yo kram ajhai chalirahechha, tyasaile himal haru bistarai aglo hudaichhan ra nepal ma bhukampa pani aauchhan.
vaccine le kasari bachauchha?

vaccine le sharir lai kamjor ya mareko kitanu, ya tesko sano bhag dekhaunchha. tyo dekhera hamro immune system le antibody banauna sikchha. pachhi sachikai rog lagyo bhane sharir le chhitai chinera ladchha, tyasaile hami dherai birami pardainau.
internet kasari chalchha?

internet bhaneko sansar bhari ka computer haru ek apas ma jodiyeko jaal ho. tapai le website kholda tapai ko phone le request pathaunchha, tyo cable, fiber ra tower hudai server samma pugchha, ani server le data sana packet ma tukryayera farkauchha. phone le packet jodera page dekhauchha.
timi jasto language model le kasari kura garchha?

ma jasto language model le aghillo shabda haru herera arko shabda (token) ko sambhavana anuman garchha. training ma maile dherai nepali text padhera kun shabda pachhi kun aauchha bhanne pattern sikhe. jawaf dinda ma ek ek token chhanera lekhchhu, tyasaile ma kahile kahi galti pani garna sakchhu.
atom k ho?

atom bhaneko padartha ko sabai bhanda sano ekai ho jasle tyo tatwa ko gun bokchha. bich ma nucleus hunchha jasma proton ra neutron hunchhan, ra waripari electron ghumchhan. pani ko euta molecule ma 2 hydrogen ra 1 oxygen atom hunchha.
ritu kina pharak pharak hunchha?

prithvi aafno aksha ma karib 23.5 degree dhalkeko chha. ghaam ko waripari ghumda kahile uttari bhag ghaam tira dhalkinchha, tyo bela garmi hunchha; kahile tadha dhalkinchha, tyo bela jado. tyasaile ritu badalinchha, prithvi ra ghaam ko duri le haina.
monsoon k ho? nepal ma kahile aauchha?

monsoon bhaneko mausami hawa ho jasle samudra bata osilo badal lyaunchha. nepal ma prayah jestha ko anta tira suru bhayera bhadau/asoj samma rahanchha. barsha ko dherai jaso pani yahi bela parchha, jun kheti ko lagi mahatwapurna chha tara pahiro ra badhi ko khatara pani lyauchha.
din ra raat kina hunchha?
prithvi afno aksha ma karib 24 ghanta ma ek palta ghumchha. jun bhag ghaam tira farkinchha tyaha din, ra ulto bhag ma raat hunchha.
aakash nilo kina dekhinchha?

ghaam ko seto prakash ma sabai rang hunchhan. hawa ka sana kanaharu le chhoto wavelength bhayeko nilo prakash lai dherai chhariyaunchhan, tyasaile jata herda pani nilo prakash aankha ma aauchha ra aakash nilo dekhinchha.
paani 100 degree ma kina umlinchha?

samudra satah ma hawa ko chap le garda pani 100 degree celsius ma umlinchha. mathi pahad ma hawa ko chap kam hunchha, tyasaile pani alik kam tapkram mai umlinchha. tyasaile himal tira daal pakauna dherai samaya lagchha.
DNA bhaneko k ho?

DNA bhaneko hamro koshika bhitra rahane lamo molecule ho jasma sharir banaune ra chalaune nirdesan code ko rupma lekhiyeko hunchha. aama buwa bata aadha aadha DNA paincha, tyasaile hami unijasta dekhinchhaun.
climate change le nepal lai kasari asar garchha?

tapkram badhda himal ko hiu ra glacier pagliraheka chhan, glacial lake phutne khatara badhchha. barsha ko dhanchha badlinda khaderi ra badhi dubai badhchhan. yasle kheti, pani ko srot ra pahadi basobas ma asar garchha.
chandrama ko aakar kina badalinchha?

chandrama aafai chamkindaina, ghaam ko prakash pharkauchha. prithvi ko waripari ghumda hamile tesko ujyalo bhag kahile dherai, kahile thorai dekhchhaun. tyasaile purnima, aunshi ra bich ka aakar dekhinchhan. ek chakra karib 29.5 din ko hunchha.
explain machine learning in simple english

Machine learning is a way for computers to learn patterns from examples instead of following hand-written rules. You show the model many examples, it makes guesses, measures how wrong it was, and adjusts its numbers a little each time. After enough examples it can make good guesses on new data.
heart le k kaam garchha?

mutu (heart) le ragat lai sharir bhari pump garchha. ragat le oxygen ra poshak tatwa sabai koshika samma puryauchha ra carbon dioxide farkauchha. thulo manchhe ko mutu minet ma karib 60 dekhi 100 palta dhadkinchha.
